## Who
Win Yu — Cloud, Data & AI Solutions Architect, based in Taipei, Taiwan.
Current: IT Manager / Product Data Supervisor at RHINOSHIELD.

## TL;DR
10+ years across data platforms, search, serverless, and GenAI on AWS.
- Architected a product-data platform (SSOT / Data Mesh) covering ~80% of the business supply chain; internal BI users 30 → 140.
- Built production Semantic AI Search on AWS: OpenAI CLIP embeddings on a SageMaker endpoint + Amazon OpenSearch vector search + Amazon Bedrock; the image-to-image channel took 7% of orders in its placement within two months.
- Operated a 24TB Amazon OpenSearch cluster under heavy MLOps load; cut ~US$15K/year via right-sizing and automated shard balancing.
- AWS Certified AI Practitioner. Speaker at AWS Summit 2025 and AWS Retail Forum 2024 (Data Mesh).
